attchmntText: Vishal Nirmiti Limited has informed the Exchange about Copy of Newspaper Publication
voiceSummary: Vishal Nirmiti Limited submitted newspaper publications of the extract of un-audited standalone financial results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026. The publications were published on November 15, 2026, in the Mumbai editions of Financial Express in English and Sakal in Marathi. The company requests the National Stock Exchange of India Limited and BSE Limited to take these publications on record. The submission was made by Mr. Suhas Ganpat Naik, Company Secretary and Compliance Officer, on behalf of the Board of Directors.

attchmntText: Vishal Nirmiti Limited has submitted to the Exchange, the financial results for the period ended September 30, 2026.
voiceSummary: Vishal Nirmiti Limited intimates the outcome of its Board Meeting held on 14th November, 2026. The Board approved the Unaudited Financial Results, Standalone, for the quarter and half year ended 30th September 2026. The company also enclosed the limited review report on these financial results. The Board took note of the Internal Audit Report for the quarter and half year ended 30th September, 2026, along with the Action Taken Report on observations and recommendations. Additionally, the Board noted the credit rating assigned to the Company's banking facilities by the Credit Rating Agency. The meeting commenced at 12.40 P.M. and concluded at 12.52 P.M. IST.
